browser.site_approval.question: Allow {origin} in the browser on {node}? The agent on {node} asked to open this site. Approve lets it browse {origin} (this exact origin only) until you revoke it; Deny refuses.
browser.site_approval.refused_unsigned: The node's browser refused this answer: it was not signed by your operator key. Answer from the Local Operator app on your own computer.
browser.site_approval.refused_bad_signat: The node's browser refused this answer: its signature did not match the operator key installed on the node.
browser.site_approval.refused_expired: This site request expired before your answer reached the node's browser. The agent has to ask again.
browser.site_approval.refused_unreachabl: Your answer could not reach the node's browser. Nothing was approved; try again in a moment.
browser.site_approval.card_title: an agent on another machine asked to open a site — your answer is signed and sent to its browser
browser.site_approval.refused_card_misma: This site request was not signed: the card does not match the site it would approve. Nothing was approved. If the node and this computer run different Local Operator versions, update both and ask again.
browser.site_approval.refused_no_approve: The node's browser has no operator key to check answers against, so it cannot approve sites. Nothing was approved.
